svg.title: Sovereign Standard record mark
svg.desc: The open record variation of the Sovereign Standard mark: one full-frame circle, one inset square, and one shortened vertical axis.
svg.metadata: Classification: public identity asset. Source of truth: this SVG. Source construction: purchase page section 03, The record. Construction: one full-frame circle, one square inset 27 percent, and one vertical line inset 13 percent.
